description: This file defines interfaces for IPC channels within the Rialto project, including a factory class for creating IPC channel instances and the IChannel interface for managing IPC communication, connection status, and event subscription.

classes.name: IChannelFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating connected IPC channel instances, either via socket path or file descriptor.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC channel with methods for connection management, event processing, and subscription.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IChannelFactory instance.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a connected IChannel instance using a socket path.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a connected IChannel instance around a socket file descriptor.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the IPC channel from the socket.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the IPC channel is currently connected.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the epoll file descriptor associated with the channel.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for I/O events or timeout on the channel.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes at most one event on the channel.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to an event message with a handler.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from an event message using its tag.
